# Data Source: tfe_hyok_customer_key_version

This data source can be used to retrieve a Hold Your Own Keys (HYOK) customer key version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic usage

data "tfe_hyok_customer_key_version" "tfe_hyok_customer_key_version1" {
  id = "keyv-123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the HYOK customer key version.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the key version was created.
- `error` (String) Any error message associated with the HYOK customer key version.
- `key_version` (String) The version number of the customer key version.
- `status` (String) The status of the customer key version.
- `workspaces_secured` (Number) The number of workspaces secured by this customer key version.
